questions.stem: A dispatcher asks which is wider, prediction or confidence interval; which is it?

options.text: It depends on the sample size only

questions.explanation: Prediction intervals include individual error, so they are wider. They are never narrower. Sample size affects both but not the ordering.

questions.subject: STATISTICS
questions.learningObjective: State a consequence of positive autocorrelation
questions.stem: A dispatcher's residuals show positive autocorrelation; what is a likely consequence?

options.text: Overstated standard errors and low power
Understated standard errors and overconfident tests

questions.explanation: Positive autocorrelation shrinks standard errors and inflates false positives. Use time-aware methods. Do not ignore it.
questions.hint: Standard errors shrink under positive autocorr.
